arguments.command:
python3 -c "
# Net options positions from the data (in millions of euros)
data = [
    ('12/31/19', -278),
    ('01/08/20', -342),
    ('01/15/20', 323),
    ('01/22/20', -329),
    ('01/29/20', -290),
    ('02/05/20', -444),
    ('02/12/20', -549),
    ('02/19/20', -469),
    ('02/26/20', -461),
    ('03/04/20', -43),
    ('03/11/20', -72),  # Pandemic declared this week
    ('03/18/20', -24),
    ('03/25/20', -100),
    ('04/01/20', -67),
    ('04/08/20', -125),
    ('04/15/20', -197),
    ('04/22/20', -272),
    ('04/29/20', -394),
]

# Find the pandemic week index
pandemic_idx = None
for i, (date, _) in enumerate(data):
    if date == '03/11/20':
        pandemic_idx = i
        break

print(f'Pandemic declared: 03/11/20 (index {pandemic_idx})')
print()

# 5 weeks BEFORE pandemic (excluding pandemic week)
before_5weeks = data[pandemic_idx-5:pandemic_idx]
print('5 weeks BEFORE pandemic:')
before_sum = 0
for date, val in before_5weeks:
    print(f'  {date}: {val}')
    before_sum += val
print(f'Cumulative before: {before_sum}')
print()

# 5 weeks AFTER pandemic (excluding pandemic week)  
after_5weeks = data[pandemic_idx+1:pandemic_idx+6]
print('5 weeks AFTER pandemic:')
after_sum = 0
for date, val in after_5weeks:
    print(f'  {date}: {val}')
    after_sum += val
print(f'Cumulative after: {after_sum}')
print()

# Absolute difference
diff = abs(before_sum - after_sum)
print(f'Absolute difference: |{before_sum} - ({after_sum})| = {diff} million euros')
"
